about: What layer 1 of the mockup fidelity gate (test/ui-tokens.test.js) does not hold yet. tokens: a token of app/renderer/tokens.css whose value the app uses today and the mockup's shared rules (app/renderer/ui) contradict; the mockup's value is the target. fonts: a face the mockup's rules ask for that is not bundled. literals: colour and size literals per file that should name a token. The test fails on anything beyond this ledger and on an entry that no longer applies, so it only shrinks; the feature named in gate ends with it empty. Decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-15: every literal becomes a token and there is no allowlist; the mockup's token values win; JetBrains Mono Medium is bundled. m5-ui-tokens-spacing cleared the token entries (the mockup's --ruler-h, --zone-tabs, --meter-w and --focus are the tokens' values) and the literals of app/renderer/ui and of mockup.html; m5-ui-alignment-chrome clears the font entry, and the component port features (m5-ui-port-*, decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-17) the rest.

fonts.why: The mockup's rules ask for JetBrains Mono at 500 (display values, key hints); only Regular (400) is bundled in app/renderer/fonts, so both the mockup and the app draw those texts in Regular. Decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-15: Medium is bundled (the font file under the OFL text already there, one @font-face, font tests), by m5-ui-alignment-chrome. 600, which the mockup's original web-font link also loaded, is not bundled: no rule asks for it.
